_what: The top-3 membership objective. Written BEFORE the model was trained.
_why: ADMIT_TOP_K = 3 shipped, so R@3 is the product metric. Every graph this project has trained was optimised for rank 1 (MarginMSE: push gold above EVERY negative). The measured loss profile says the boundary that costs cases is rank 3 vs rank 4: of 11 fit cases lost at cond@3, gold sits at rank 4 in FIVE and rank 5-6 in four more. Only two are routs.
loss: relu(delta - (s_pos - s_neg_k)) where s_neg_k is the k-th HIGHEST negative in the query's mined negative set, k = 3. Zero loss once gold is above the 3rd negative, whatever its position inside the top 3.
selection_metric: fit-val R@3, NOT R@1. Optimising one metric and selecting on another is the proxy failure this project keeps a ledger of.
unchanged_from_arm_A: delta rule (median base margin over fit cases it already ranks first)

declared_knobs._note: Both are DECLARED, not tuned. max_negatives caps a query's negative set so one long slate cannot dominate a gradient step; the k-th highest is taken over the cap. Neither will be swept before a held-out read.

REGISTERED_PREDICTION.fit_val_R@1: FALLS OR IS FLAT. If R@1 also rises materially, the loss is probably not doing what it claims and that must be checked before believing R@3.
REGISTERED_PREDICTION.falsified_if: fit cond@3 <= 0.9511, i.e. no better than the six-way fusion it must beat
REGISTERED_PREDICTION.where_the_gain_should_come_from: cases currently at fused rank 4. If R@3 rises but the rank-4 cases are not the ones that move, the mechanism is not what is claimed.
REGISTERED_PREDICTION.collapse_risk: MODERATE. This is a training change, not a threshold, so it is unlike the four knob-collapses. But arm B was also a training change and went +0.0698 fit -> +0.0087 held-out.

heldout_policy: NOT read by the training script. One read only, and only if fit cond@3 clears 0.9511, with the configuration fixed in writing first. No sweeping of k, batch or cap beforehand.
